Class PickState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.PickState
class PickState extends GameState
State implementation that manages the active drafting phase where players interactively claim or purchase cards from the game board layout.

This class validates whether the requesting player is legally permitted to execute a pick based on current turn orders or specific end-of-round extra pick allowances (e.g., additional top row picks). It handles the subtraction of available pick actions, updates board slots, delegates resource consumption for buildings, triggers card effects, and checks for tribe workforce set completions via targeted Visitor classes.

  • Method Details

    • pickCard

      protected void pickCard(Game context, Player player, Optional<Card> card, int rowChosen) throws IllegalPickException, ForcedPickException, WrongTurnException, SQLException
      Executes a legal card drafting action requested by a player.

      The processing pipeline operates as follows:

      1. Extracts the card payload from the network-safe container wrapping the input data.
      2. Resolves whether an exceptional turn override is active (players claiming bonus top row allocations).
      3. Enforces chronological turn integrity against the top-most unfilled totem slot on the tracking pathway.
      4. Validates quantitative limits to ensure the user possesses remaining action tokens for the requested row.
      5. Branches logic based on row constants to handle character collection vs structural building purchases, updating models accordingly.
      Overrides:
      pickCard in class GameState
      Parameters:
      context - the central Game context manager directing rules and status flows
      player - the Player attempting to claim the structural layout item
      card - the Card instance being claimed from the board (must not be null)
      rowChosen - the board row identifier from which the item is being taken
      Throws:
      IllegalPickException - if the selected item violates row restrictions or remaining actions equal zero
      ForcedPickException - if the target configuration conflicts with explicit game selection constraints
      WrongTurnException - if the executing identity's turn token does not align with the current active slot layout
      SQLException - if state logging or network serialization triggers a transactional problem

    • nextState

      protected void nextState(Game context) throws SQLException, IllegalPickException, ForcedPickException
      Shifts control to the verification phase by generating a new state instance.

      Forwards control markers smoothly into ControlState and launches ControlState.controlPick(Game, boolean, Card, int) to compute next eligible turn orders.

      Specified by:
      nextState in class GameState
      Parameters:
      context - the central game monitoring instance Game
      Throws:
      SQLException - if system transaction propagation hits internal blockages
      IllegalPickException - if sequential selection validation hits a formatting failure
      ForcedPickException - if downstream parameters detect validation veto exceptions
